script_text: Something shifts irreversibly for Aquarius this week — the cosmos demands you confront what you've been avoiding. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun in Virgo squares your Uranus-ruled Air nature, creating tension in your 12th House of secrets. Mercury conjunct Mars in your 3rd House fuels bold communication but risks impulsive words Tuesday. Wednesday brings Venus entering your 7th House of partnerships, forming a trine to Neptune — opening unexpected love doors. Thursday through Sunday, Saturn supports your 10th House of career, especially Friday when the Moon enters your 2nd House of finances. The weekend brings a sextile between Jupiter and your ruling Uranus, sparking innovation. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House, activating partnerships. Monday is your challenge day because the Sun squares your Uranus, creating friction in hidden matters. Trust one intuitive impulse — it comes from Uranus guiding you correctly. Follow for daily updates.
